title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is a technique used to assess how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. It is mainly used in settings where the goal is prediction, and one wants to estimate how accurately a predictive model will perform in practice.

title: Sampling with Replacement
text: When sampling with replacement, each observation is selected independently and can be chosen more than once. Consider how this might affect the creation of cross-validation folds.

title: Cross-Validation Folds
text: Are cross-validation folds typically created by sampling with or without replacement?
